proof_scope: Read the actual canonical JSON, emitted live UI payload and PPTX; reject an unresolved native icon. Not slideshow playback or human visual approval.

cases.name: unknown-icon-refuses-import
command: cd .. && python3 -c 'import json,tempfile,subprocess; from pathlib import Path; root=Path.cwd(); b=root/"docs/pitch/oai-trial/reorganized"; d=json.loads((b/"deck.document.json").read_text()); next(e for e in d["slides"][0]["elements"] if e["kind"]=="icon")["icon"]["library_id"]="unregistered-icon"; t=tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir="/mnt/storage12tb/oai-trial/canonical-import"); p=Path(t.name); (p/"bad.json").write_text(json.dumps(d)); r=subprocess.run([str(Path.home()/"workspace/experiments/agent-skills/skills/pitchdeck/run.sh"),"emit-document-ui","--document",str(p/"bad.json"),"--asset-base",str(b),"--output-dir",str(p/"ui")],capture_output=True,text=True); assert r.returncode!=0 and not (p/"ui/deck.data.json").exists(); assert "not in the library manifest" in r.stdout+r.stderr; print("UNKNOWN_ICON_REFUSED")'
